title: balancingPeriodValue
description: One balancing quantity for an explicitly bounded UTC time interval.

periodStart.description: UTC timestamp marking the inclusive start of the balancing interval.

periodEnd.description: UTC timestamp marking the exclusive end of the balancing interval.

quantity.description: Balancing quantity for the interval in the unit defined by balancingData.unit. Positive and negative values are permitted.

quality.description: Quality or processing status of the balancing quantity.

x-enumDescriptions.preliminary: The value is based on preliminary data and may still be updated within the applicable balancing process.
x-enumDescriptions.prognosis: The value is a forecast for a future interval or a future balancing state.
x-enumDescriptions.closed: The value has been fixed after completion of the relevant balancing period and is no longer changed within the continuous balancing process.
x-enumDescriptions.final: The value is final and is based on final data or final allocations.

helperCauser.description: Designation of the balancing group as Helper or Causer for the relevant cumulative balancing value.

x-enumDescriptions.Helper: The balancing group contributes positively to the relevant balancing situation according to the applicable Helper/Causer assessment.
x-enumDescriptions.Causer: The balancing group contributes negatively to the relevant balancing situation according to the applicable Helper/Causer assessment.
